messages:
Maya P: FYI created a first-pass dashboard for the new runtime metrics we discussed. Link: https://dash.re/redwood/runtime-new (private)
ops-bot: dashboard created by Maya P: runtime/serve/kv-cache-and-slos
Anil R: Nice. What's the scope? latency, kv hit, seq hist?
Maya P: p99/p50 latency, kv_cache_hit_ratio, inflight_requests, seq_len_hist (buckets), model_memory_bytes, quantized_path_ratio. Also an eval panel for model fallback counts.
Sara L: Can we get a separate panel for prefix cache hit over 1s windows? that's where most cost wins are.
Greg H: Agree. For alerts — propose two alert sets: operational (p99 latency > 500ms, error_rate > 0.5%) and cost/quality (SLO burn > 2 for 5m). Also a KV cache drop alert when hit_ratio drops below 60% over 10m.
Julia (eng-oncall): How do you want routing mapped? primary eng-runtime, secondary eng-sre, tertiary eng-oncall? We need a runbook link in the pager.
Maya P: Yes. Primary=eng-runtime, secondary=eng-sre, escalation=eng-oncall. Add runbook url: https://wiki/re/redwood/runbooks/runtime-alerts
Anil R: Proposed Prometheus rule snippet:
```
- alert: Runtime_P99_Latency_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "runtime p99 latency > 500ms"
```
Greg H: For SLO burn use: slo_burn_rate = sum(increase(error_budget_used[5m])) / sum(error_budget_total) ??? let's use existing slo-exporter metric `slo_burn_rate{service="runtime"}` > 2 for 10m.
Sara L: Also add a "sticky" ticket if KV drop persists >30m so infra can investigate config/evictions.
Maya P: Ops: can eng-sre help tune alert thresholds for noisy endpoints? We want low noise for async batch jobs.
ops-bot: @eng-sre requested: please review thresholds; ticket #INC-4527 created.
Greg H: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to add grafana panels + template variables (model, region); 2) eng-sre to review alert rules and SLO burn mapping; 3) eng-oncall to confirm routing and runbook; 4) product to confirm which model variants should be treated as fallback (affects SLO).
Julia (eng-oncall): Confirmed routing and will add oncall links. We'll test a synthetic alert on staging Thursday 10:00 PT — tagging @all.
Maya P: I'll push dashboard JSON to repo `infra/dashboards/runtime` and open PR. tagging @Anil @Greg for review.
Anil R: LGTM on plan. I'll follow up with tweaks to quantile query.
Sara L: Thanks all. If anyone has objections to thresholds, speak now or at review PR.
Maya P: thanks! :thumbsup:
